# `RegressionViolationException`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\RegressionViolationException`

**Class** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/RegressionViolationException.php#L21) — **Version:** working tree

**Extends:** `RuntimeException`

**Implements:** `Stringable`, `Throwable`

Reported when a recorded regression fails again: the minimised input of an
earlier failure, replayed from the on-disk corpus (`PROPERTY_DB`) before the
random phase.

The input is already minimal — it is the shrunk counterexample of the run that
recorded it — so it is replayed once and reported verbatim, without shrinking.
A regression stored as a bare seed instead of values replays the whole random
phase and reports the usual [`PropertyViolationException`](/api/classes/PropertyViolationException).

| `$seed` | `int` | *required* | Seed of the run that originally recorded this regression. |
| `$failure` | `?\Throwable` | `NULL` | The assertion or exception the replay raised. |
